entities.summary: Maria Xaveria Perucona or Parruccona was an Italian nun and composer. Her only known work, Sacri concerti de motetti a una, due, tre, e quattro voce, dates from 1675, and is a set of eighteen motets. Maria Xaveria Perucona was a religious figures from Novara (1650, Novara–1709). Holds notable historical significance, documented across 0 language editions of Wikipedia.
